about_the_game:
The eternal darkness of the dungeons dragged the brave knight in golden armor into an endless maze of dangers. The gloomy corridors are full of treacherous traps, golden chests and terrible monsters hunting anyone who dares to enter the dungeon. But the main test is to calculate your actions, because the adventurer's steps are limited.

Knightventure

This is a step — it's a nuelike view from above, where each level is new, but you need to finish it and defuse the traps, but you need to finish it and defuse the traps, but you need to finish it and defuse the traps, but you need to finish it and defuse the traps, but you need to finish it in the abyss forever.The next level or you will stay in the abyss forever.The next level or you will stay in the abyss forever.

Game Features:

  • Limited number of moves per level: plan every move;

  • A variety of monsters and traps;

  • Randomly generated dungeons for endless replayability;

  • A system for upgrading armor and weapons between attempts.
